Best food we have had in Vietnam
Oct 2019

My partner is really fussy with food but it is by far the best meat we have eaten. You BBQ your own, the menu is in English. The owner is English speaking and really friendly and went above and beyond on each visit to make sure we had a good meal. He even did some BBQ'ing for us! Love this place and highly reccomend paying it a visit.

Really tasty food and good fun
Apr 2018 • Couples
We ate here tonight after reading about it on TripAdvisor. We got there quite late, around 9:30pm and it was nearly empty. As a result of this we got served straight away. A man who I assume was the owner gave us a hand choosing from the menu and all of his recommendations were delicious. We liked what we had so much that we ordered some more meals once we had finished the first ones. The man who helped us had a good sense of humor and there were plenty of jokes between courses. He even talked me into trying frogs legs which I loved. Would definitely recommend here
